purpose: Species-switching replant yield curves (fresh-fuchs phase P6, issue UBC-FRESH/fresh-fuchs#48): pure-plantation BTC curves for replanting each tsa29mini source AU with PL / SW (canonical SX) / FD.

input.si_source: parent tsa29 instance data/03_input-tsa29.csv rows keyed by au_table.source_managed_local_au_id; source-AU reference SI flat-transferred to the target species column (documented simplification)

runtime.wine_mono: wine-mono-9.0.0-x86.msi installed into scratch wineprefix (TIPSYbtc.exe is a 64-bit .NET assembly; Mono required)
runtime.display: userspace Xvfb (dpkg-extracted xvfb 21.1.12 + x11-xkb-utils + xkb-data; Xvfb binary string-patched: /usr/bin->/tmp/xkb, /usr/share/X11/xkb->/tmp/xkb/share/xkb, /var/lib/xkb/->/tmp/xkb/out/); DISPLAY=:99, -screen 0 1024x768x16
runtime.btc_install: tipsy_io/scratch/btc_install (copied from prior UBC-FRESH integration evidence staging; includes TimberSupply.rpt report template)

outputs.curves_csv: data/tipsy_curves_tsa29mini_replant.csv (femic parse_btc_tsr_transposed_output long format: AU, Age, Yield, Height, DBHq, TPH, GrossYield, CrownCover)

validation.si_ordering: L <= M <= H holds for PL and FD in all strata; SW shows M>H max-yield inversions in SBPS_PLI, SBPS_SX, IDF_PLI that exactly replicate the parent tsa29 native SW curves (bit-identical for SBPS_SX L/M/H, max|diff|=0.0) — inherited TIPSY behaviour, not a transfer artifact
validation.monotonicity: net merchantable yield declines slightly post-culmination on some PL curves (max 1.7 m3/ha per 10-yr step) — expected TIPSY mortality behaviour, not cumulative volume
validation.identity_check: replant SW curves for SBPS_SX L/M/H are bit-identical to parent tsa29 curves 21010/22010/23010 (same species, SI, and regime)

known_limitations: Flat SI transfer: target species grows at the source AU's reference SI (no species-specific site-index conversion equations applied)
Provisional TIPSY config lineage (codex-provisional; final calibration should be RESULTS/SPAR opening-level)
Species mixes not yet generated (descoped from this pass; pure options only)
No OT (other) TIPSY representation; OT replant keeps the synthetic/proxy path in fresh-fuchs
